sources.title: RAPID³

sources.title: H2-Cache
sources.verification: Primary abstract/full-text retrieved: hierarchical dual-stage cache in Flux; no Cosmos functional group equivalence assumed.

sources.title: PAB
sources.verification: Primary paper retrieved: attention broadcast related work; no local deployment.

sources.title: DuCa

sources.title: OmniCache: Multidimensional Hierarchical Feature Caching
sources.verification: Primary abstract and methods 3.4: token/frame/block/layered caches and layer-timestep budget scheduling. Distinct from ICCV2025 trajectory-oriented OmniCache.

sources.title: LiteAttention
sources.verification: Primary paper retrieved and abstract: temporal sparsity reuse; feature/mask lifetime distinction is an unvalidated local question.

sources.title: PSA
sources.verification: Primary abstract: multilevel pooled KV versus binary masking; deferred representation hierarchy; no local kernel/model verification.
